scope: First listed compatible checkpoint per model, fixed synthetic odd rectangle 5x3; no test or satellite pixels. Higher scales are repeated learned native2 with bicubic residual and per-stage uint8 quantization. Temporary exports removed after verification.
memory_method: Process RSS sampled every10ms, includes loaded libraries/prior allocator state; sampled maximum is not guaranteed peak or per-job allocation. No maximum-size execution claim.
